tei:div.tei:p: (1na1)༄༅// dpal padma dkar po'i gsung mgur zhal gdams kyi rim pa 'thor bu bzhugs so//

"$ (1ba2)༄༅// snying po'i lam la mdzub btsugs nas// dag pa rab 'byams sar skyel ba// 'gro ba'i ded dbon 'brug pa'i zhabs// byang chub phyin kyi bar du mchod// gzhung brgya smra ba'i kong ston khyod// lung dang rigs pas rmongs pa ci// de la nan brtag bya mi 'tshal// yang dag 'jog khyer cung zad bshad// tshig gi tha dad mi mdzad par// don gyi ru ma ci 'dug ltos// gnas lugs gtan la 'bebs pa la// mdo sngags gnyis ka blo rtse gcig /'on kyang dngos zin 'bebs khyer la// zab dang yang zab bla ma gsung*// phar phyin theg pa'i 'jug sgo la// dpyad sgom 'jog sgom rnam gnyis snang*// thos pas sgro 'dogs legs dpyad nas// sgom la 'jug pa snga ma'i lugs// 'di la thos don sems pa'i ring*// sgom skad btags kyang bsam byung yin// re zhig brtag dpyad tsam bzhag nas// rnam par mi rtog gang skye bya// zhi gnas sems rnyed brtan par bya// ji tsam bzhag lo gnas par nus// de yi ngo bo dran pa yin/ dran pa yengs pa med la btags/ ma yengs pa na 'gyur ba rig /rig pa'i cha de shes bzhin yin// de nyid dus gcig nyid byung bas// dran shes 'jug pa gcig tu gsungs// thun la 'jug dang thun nas su// sngar gyi thos don la sems la// dngos gzhi'i dus su mi rtog gzhag /sbyor dus rten rgyu tha dad pas// dngos gzhi so so sor 'gyur// des na zhi gnas yid byed lam// bsam gtan bzhi pa dag thob nas// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul 'byung ba'i phyir// de 'dod pa rnams de la 'jug /'dod sems rtse gcig la brten nas// lhag mthong bgrod pa rkyang grol bzhin// zag med lam gyi khyad par gyis// nyan thos pa bzhin 'di mi 'gyur// thos pas (2na3)sgro 'dogs ma chod kyang*// bla ma'i man ngag tsam bsten nas// rnam par mi rtog bsgom pa la// 'jog sgom pa zhes ding sang grags// gnyis kar rtse gcig sems brtan dad// shes bzhin gyis dpyod sor rtog ste// lhag mthong dngos rgyu 'di yin gyi// lung rigs dpyad pas mi rtogs te// de ni kha phyir phyogs pa dang*// gnas lugs nang phyogs rang rig las// gzung 'dzin gyis btang gsal rig shar// rang ngo rang gis shes snyam rjes// rtse gcig sems las 'gyur tsam mthong*// 'gyur ba rang dus las mi gnas// 'gyur mthong nyid dus rang grol ba// thog sbrul thag par mthong ba bzhin// mthong dang mthong bya brtags na stong*// ma dpyad sgyu ma tsam du snang*// gang shar ngos zin 'di la zer// des ni dmigs pa nyon mongs dang*// spyod pa kun la 'di rig pas// gang zhig spang rgyu su yis spong*// ji ltar byas spong mi dmigs pas// spang blang med pa'i lam 'di yis// chos kun gdod nas gnas par 'byor// de phyir lhan cig skyes sbyor gsungs// cung zad snang rgyu dmigs rgyu yong*// de srid ngo shes rang grol yod// rnam rtog chos skur 'char skabs yin// ltag mthong mngon sum gyur pa zer// snang dmigs thams cad dag pa na// 'bras bu phyag rgya chen por song*// de ni kun khyab phyogs cha bral// byis pa'i blo yis rtogs pa min// sangs rgyas kho na'i gzhal bya'o// des na mtshan nyid dngos zin la// brgyud pas nyon mongs 'dul ba yin// shar dus grol ba 'di'i gnad kyis// gsang sngags pa rnams dngos rgyu 'joms// nyon mongs nyid mthong byang chub tu// zab mo'i mdo las kyang gsungs pas// phugs su mdo sngags dgongs pa gcig

/ces kong yul rdo rje gdan nas padma dkar pos spur steng chos sde'i slob dpon kong ston gzhung brgya smra bgrags pa rin chen la bsrings pa'o/// /gzung 'dzin (2ba4)gyi 'char sgo drag pa'i tshe// 'du 'dzi g.yeng bas 'byams gyur na// mkhas mkhas bslab pa pag shir song*// bden med du 'char ba zhig dgos dgos 'dra// nyon mongs kyi rlung 'tshub langs pa'i tshe// gnyen po gar khyer ma byung ba'i// btsun btsun skad byas tshul 'chos yin// zhi dul du song ba cig dgos pa 'dra// chos brgyad kyi rba glong 'khrug tsa na// mgo snyoms kyi gru bo 'chag mkhan de// zhig zhig skad byas kyang bzang brdzu yin// ro snyoms su 'gro ba zhig dgos pa 'dra// chags sdang gi mtshon rtse gzings tsa na// sdug bsngal len zhig mi bsam pa'i// blo sbyong sbyong byas kyang rengs po yin// bdag gzhan mnyam nyid gcig dgos pa 'dra// zhes rab 'byams smra ba sangs rgyas rdo rje la gdams pa'o/// /dus snyigs mar gyur pa'i gnas skabs 'dir// chags sdang gi glong na ban btsun 'khyam// mi gzhan ma'i phun tshogs mi bzod 'khrugs// 'di bsams kyin grong yul gyi phyogs la byol// zang zing gi 'du long dug gi zas// 'bags che kyin thar pa'i srog la gzan// de bas chags med kyi bya btang la// chos 'dul ba'i snying por bsams nas zhugs// rgyud chos brgyud gcig dang ma bral ring*// yengs med kyi zhi gnas gser las dkon// des na zhen yul gyi steng 'di ru// lung rigs kyi ral gris cis mi bsnun// gar gtang la lhod de sdod tshugs na// rnam rtog gi g.yo sgyu de kar 'jig /nyams bde gsal ba'i glong na rig pa shar// bden 'dzin la 'joms byed dpa' bor song*// nyon mongs pa'i rang mtshang de na rig /spang rgyu zhig med pa lag tu lon// thob med kyi 'bras bu thob pa la// dka' tshegs med snyam nges shes skyed// ces mtshan sgrog mkhan chen gyis bskul bas padma dkar pos glur bgyis so/// /zang zang ne ring gi sgrub chen pa// sras bde legs rgyal mtshan gyi rnam (3na5)thar skyong*// pha rjes bus 'dzin gyi dpa' dar la// nor dngos po'i zhen pa log pas na// gtam dbyangs su bsnyad pa'i bslab bya byed// de zhib mor brtags la blang dor mdzod// gsar bu yi ge nag thug dus// go la re nas slob pas ngal// zur go tsam nas tsam gyis gzhog

/snying rus can gyis blo gsal thon// mi gzhan mas slob dpon 'ong res btud// gzhan las zab khyad ches bsam nas// tshig gya gyu cig la khrid khrid nas// gzhung lugs kyi tshugs kha shor nas thal// thos bsam pa yi 'bub pa yin// thos pa byas pa'i dgos pa de// tshig las don mtshon don yang ni// drang nges gnyis las nges don 'khril// sgo 'dogs med pa dgos rgyur gda'// gzhon dus gdams ngag sna res thos// gsar 'grogs byas nas bsgoms pa'i mthus// nyams su myong ba sna re rnyed// brod ka skyes nas ri la bsdad// lto gos gnyis la gyong khur bas// mi chos pa rnams dad pa skyes// sngas srungs rim gror spyan 'dren byas// grong ltag gcig tu dgon pa bcas// nyams kyi snang ba 'du 'dzis khyer// sgyur 'gong legs phyogs sgrub rtags rlom// sgom chen rnams kyi 'bub sar mthong*// bsgoms pa'i dgos pa gang yin na// ting nge 'dzin gyis dngos snang bshig /shes rab zab mos zhen pa phyung*// chos brgyad mgo bo snyoms gyur pas// rgas kyin ri khrod je mthor gtong*// byis pa zhig nas dkor la bzas// rnam rig bkra na re ba che// 'jun mkhan yod ring bstod ra yong*// rang dbang thob nas bag yangs kyis// mi nag pa las bu gtsis che// bya byed de yi ched du spung*// rgas kar dkor smin sdug la gtad// brgyud can bla ma'i 'bub sar mthong*// brgyud pa ngom pa'i dgos pa de// pha mes bya ba'i srol bzung nas// sde dgon gud pa bsrung ba dang*// rang nyid ngan 'gror mi 'khyam tsam// kha zhe mthun pa dgos rgyur gda'// dad pa can gyis (3ba6)bsnyen bkur byas// rgyal khams rnams su mtshan snyan grags// 'dus pa char sprin lta bur 'du// nor rdzas ri ltar spungs tsa na// rang gis chog par mi 'dzin par// gzhan ma'i de yang bsnyab la rings// 'og tu ma 'dus rtsod pa 'dzugs// nga ris dmag dpon chen po de// bla chen rnams kyi 'bub sar mthong*// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma ni// bsags pa gzhan la phan par sbyor// 'dus pa chos la 'god pa dang*// kun mthun kun la gang phan sgrub// 'brel tshad don ldan byed pa lags// zang zang ni ring gi sgrub chen chos skyong bde legs kyis gser la sogs pa'i rnyed pa phul// lhag par sgrub tshugs dpe med pa gzung*// da dung 'jig rten chos brgyad ser srungs thu bos ser ba la bzhin/

gdong bzlog tu byed pa'i bya dgar/ shar kong po'i za yul phu dkar rgyud chos sdings su sbyar ba'o/// /sngar byas pa'i sdig dang ltung ba tsho/ sems 'gyod pas bshags shing bsdams pas 'dag /de ma byas nyon mongs skye ba'i tshang*// ngan song gi sdug bsngal 'byung sa yin// dus gsum gyi dge ba gzhan don btang*/ de bla med byang chub chen por bsngo// bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs de las 'byung*// sangs rgyas shig sgrub na med ka med// dge sdig gi rtsa ba sems la thug /sems sems su gzung na gol nas 'gro// sems stong nyid du shes na lam gyis 'khyer// sgyu 'phrul bya rol rtse bya ba'i grogs// zhes la stod lho pa dge slong 'phrin las rgya mtsho la gdams pa'o/// /rjod byed lung gi sgo nas rnam mang yang*// ci bshad snying po gcig tu 'khril bas su// rang sar bden dang thugs gcig mdzub btsugs pa// chos kyi bla mar 'os kyis mi dbang sten// dri bral shel la tshon chags min na yang*// gab rtse gang du btsal ba'i gdangs 'gyur bzhin// mos dang khams dang bag la zhi dbang gis/ gsung gcig rnam pa mang por song ba (4na7)las// sprin bcas sprin med dus na'ang nam mkha'i khams// rnam par ma gyur de bzhin chos dbyings la// sems can sangs rgyas dbye ba med 'dis su// bshad bya gcig tu mi 'bab ka med yin// des na gcig shes kun grol bsgrub pa yis// thob pa'i snying po bsam pa'i lhun chags pas// sgom byung 'bras bu'i dpal byi dga' char byis// 'jig rten khams kun 'dod dgus tshim par 'gyur// 'di mkhyen 'dod pa'i sde la rgyab phyogs pa// gangs dang ri sul nags phug dben par mod// rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor du lang long min// shākya'i ring lugs rang ni de lags so// nor dang cher 'gying chos kyis bsgrub bya na// 'khor los bsgyur ba'i srid spangs nags rgyu ci// bza' btung ga zha bya ba'i snying yin na// klog dang spong bar bstan 'dzin bsnyan nas ci// sde dgon khe 'tshol gsog 'jog byed pa dang*// thal 'gyur sngo phyer song ba'i tshig sbyangs dang*// snying pos 'phongs pas phaṭa brjod srang rgyu rnams// mod kyang chos su song snyam ma mchis pa// rgyal po chos kyi snang ba mchog gi mdun// dam tshig ngo mtshar gzigs mo 'bul zhos snyam// legs bshad tshig re'i stang stabs nyams 'gyur gyi// rtsed 'jor bgyi 'dir spyan ras btsa' bar 'os// zhes pa rin spungs sde pa chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang nor bu bzang po la gdams pa'o/// /rigs kun bdag rdo rje 'chang chen yang*// mtshan ldan gyi bla ma 'di ka lags// logs shig nas skyabs gnas 'tshol mi dgos// da sa sde btsugs nas gsol ba thob// thag nye ring la bltos pa ma mchis pas// rang 'dod pa'i don kun bde blag 'thob// yon tan kun skye ba'i zhing sa de// yul khyad par can la dad pa yin// gang dad pa ldan na sdig las zlog

/dge tshogs yar spel la spro ba tsho// bzod pa'i go cha dang gis rnyed// brtson 'grus kyi rta la de zhon nas// bsam (4ba8)gtan gyi bde ba'i dga' ston can// shes rab kyi mkhar bzangs su yud kyi 'gro// ma tshor bar thar pa'i sa la snyogs// bla med kyi gser lam de dus rnyed// chos byas so snyam med pa'i dad zhig la// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su song lags pa// 'di dwags pa dkar rgyud kyi zang khyad yin// glegs bam gral bsgrigs tsho'i brjod don yin// tha snyad mkhan gyi bshad pa yin// sgom chen ri 'dzin gyi bcud len yin// khyim pa byang sems kyi rnam thar yin// khyed mi dbang dad can gyi chos skal mdzod// chos bshad pa mdo ru ma 'gril na// tshig rigs kyi bshar byang zin dus med// mdo don nyams su ma blangs na// shes kyang khrom gtam zad ma yin// nyams su myong ba'i dus tsa na// de la yengs med cig gces pa yin// 'di yang gri gug nas sde pa dgos dgos kyis zhus pa'i ngor gnang ba'o/// /mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rin po che// dad pa can gyi gtsug rgyan na// yid bzhin nor bu nyid du mthong*// dgos 'dod zhu sa bzang lags nas// mi nga'i blo gtad de ka yin// de bas de yi rjes su slob// chos bzang po'i rtsa ba byang sems yin// kun la nye ring mi 'byed par// rnam grol lam la 'god par 'dod// mi nga'i nyams len de ka yin// de bas 'bangs la byams brtses skyong*// skye bo phal cher khram pa can// kha zhu gting 'khyags kyi dpe ru gda'// zhu ba'i stabs su mi btang bar// 'thad dam mi 'thad brtags nas byed// mi kho bo'i spyod 'gros de ka yin// mi rgyal khyod kyang de ltar mdzod// chos kyi rgyal po bya ba'i sde pa dmag dpon chen pos bskul ba'i ngor padma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// /tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rgan po'i grogs// dben par bag phebs bsnyad bya snyan pa'i bcud// yid kyi bdud rtsi ster ba'i 'phrin yig gi// 'dab brgya gad de bdag mdun 'khrigs par gyur// bdag kyang mkhas rlom khur gyis mnon cing*// tshe 'dir (5na9)chags pa'i sgyid snyoms rgyang dor nas// grub pa'i phyir rjes snyeg pa'i spyod tshul gyis// nags mtha' thar 'dod re ba skong bzhin mchis// ched don mkhas rlom chu shing nags khrod du// dri ba'i sta re bzod pa mi rnyed par// drang por snra la tshig lan 'di dag ni// mdza' bos mngags pa'i pho nya bzhin du byung*// 'on kyang rgyal rigs sā la'i tshal 'khrungs pa// rnam dpyod me tog phon bu'i snyan dngags kyi// dri bsung zhim pos bdag yid mgu byas kyang*// brjod don 'bras bus 'phongs phyir tshim pa ci// log rtog ba mo'i 'jug pas ma bcom par// bshes gnyen ston ka'i dus cig bsten gyur na// mkhas pa dga' ba'i legs bshad 'bras bu ni// mi dbang a mra'i shing der chags snyam sems// dpyod ldan de yid re ba'i lan gyi cha// phul byung rig pa dang ldan lung sbyar ba// bsrings pa'i glegs bu 'di la kun rtog gi// pir brgyas ri mor mdzod ces khyod kyis gsol// gleng pas dri tshig 'ben gang ma mthong bas// lan du smra ba'i zol sbyor mda' 'phangs pa// blun po'i khrom pa bzhad gad skyed mod kyang*// dpyod ldan 'phongs mkhas rnams ni khrel ba'i rgyu// gzu lums can dang rtsod pa don med pas// bdag sems btang snyoms na mang khyod tshig gis// ring nas bskul ba ma lhogs mtshan tsam zhig

/slan chad 'chal gtam mi smra'i ched du sbyar// 'phags pa'i yul du mchis 'dra smra ba'i grwar// rgol dang phyir rgol gang rung khas blangs nas// bstan pa dpang btsugs rtsod pas mchog gyur na// bdag sems dga' yang gangs ri'i khrod 'dir min/// /sems can thams cad drin can ma lags pas// bde 'dod sdug bsngal bral na bsam pa'i blos// bla med byang chub sgrub par dam bca' ba// theg pa chen po'i chos kyi 'jug sgo yin// bsam pas rang don zhi ba rgyang brims nas// lus ngag gzhan gyi bran du bkol nus te// (5ba10)yongs su bsngo ba'i rgyas 'debs la 'bad na// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i lam mchog yin// dngos kun sems la sems nyid stong pas na// yengs med dran pa'i rgyun lam ma chad pa'i// ci snang de khar 'dzin med 'jog nus na// dmigs med ma dang mjal ba chos nyid yin// lus lha brjod pa sngags su yid ches kyi// dbang po che mdun sdug bsngal ga la yod// thams cad bde bar 'bar phyir g.yugs bgyis dang*// phyag rgya chen po'i glong du brgyal te 'gro// zhes phag mo lha khang nas gdams so/// /khyed sngon gyi las 'phro chos su sad// gzhon nu nyid nas chos sgor 'tshangs// bla ma mang po'i zhal skyin lon// de phyir snyan bskul ga la dgos// 'on kyang yang dag lam gyi gnad// ma nor dpal ldan 'brug pa'i gsung*// kho bo'i mgrin par 'khyil ba mang*// cung zad ston gyis legs par gson// yang dag blangs pa'i tshul khrims kyis// 'dod yon lnga la gdong 'ded thong*// btsun pa rang du de nas sleb// thar pa'i rmang gzhi things pa lags// thos pa byas pa'i chos thams cad// rang gi rgyud thog 'bebs tshugs na// mkhas pa rang de de la zer// thos pa'i snying po sgrub par brtsigs// nyams su blangs pa'i drod rtags des// tshe 'di'i snang shas sdug zad btang*// zhig po rang de de la 'ong*// gcig shes kun grol mkhar du longs// rang rgyud rtogs pa ldan tsa na// thabs la mkhas pa'i 'khor lo bsgyur// 'gro don rang cig de la 'byung*// mthong thos dran reg thams cad 'tshengs// de ltar gzhi lam 'bras bu'i bar// e bden gzigs na yang dag ste// mi shes dri ba byed pa'i ngor// rdzun po dkyu ba'i bla ma min// thug sar thug pa'i gnad ka des// tha snyad tshig sgum gsog ma khom// shākya thub dang 'gal dogs pas// nor rdzas sgrub rtsol byed ma nus// gzhan la sgro 'dog skur btab nas// (6na11)sdig la bre gsog byed ma shes// dam chos snying la zug pa'i phyir// rgyal khams mi dang bstun pa min// mkha' 'gro chos skyong khros dogs nas// chos 'gal dang du len la zhed// sgra rnams brag char mtshungs mthong bas// bstod smad mnyam pa nyid du btang*// blo bde phugs su 'tshangs pas na// 'phral snang thams cad bde bar shar// a la la ho bla ma'i drin// lan lon par dka' yang brtse bas skyongs// gyang mtho sprul sku bde chen rol pa la padma dkar pos 'brug chos sding nas bsrings pa dge legs 'phel ba'i rkyen du gyur cig// /yang dag phul gyi lam nas 'gro ba kun// rnam byang rdo rje'i sa la 'dod mkhas pa// mtshungs pa med pa'i rje btsun 'brug pa'i zhibs// kun gyi cod pan 'os der gsol ba 'debs// gang gi bshad pa'i ma nus sar 'khod pa'i 'gro// dbyangs can mgrin par 'chang ba 'ba' zhig bzhin// legs bshad snying gar 'tshangs rnams nyer zhi ba'i// bdud rtsis tshim par gyur la phyag 'tshal lo// las dge ba nyid du 'gyur mi 'gyur// rang sems kyi bsam tshul nyid la rag

/rtse gcig gis dad pa'i las byas na// thar pa'i rgyu ru the mi tshom// spros med mngon par byang chub ma mthong na// spros bcas dmigs pa'i chos kyi mtha' mi chod// des na sgo gsum g.yeng ba rgyang bong la// rang sems dran pa'i ra bas bskor ba 'thad// tshur bkug dran pa'i go bas tshugs mi thub// ma bcos rang tshugs thub na de kha'i gor// rkyen snang phra rags gnyis med 'byor bar sem// de tshe chu la chu gzhag lta bur 'gyur// zhes gdams so/// /dpal dgam po'i bka' brgyud snyan grags che// sgos sgrub pa'i bka' babs 'brug par thug /sems yid gnyis med pas gsol btab na// don snying po gcer mthong the mi tshom// las byas pa mdo yod sems can don// rang skyid phyir min na tshogs gnyis 'phel// (6ba12)'bras sku gnyis lag pa'i rtse la bzhugs// chos rgyud la khel na zer tshad bden// 'di yang jo gdan mkhan por gnang ba'o/// /mtha' med khams gsum 'khor ba 'dir 'khyams shing*// mi bzod sdug bsngal drag po myong gyur tshe// bdag cag khyed la re sa mi zhu na// gzhan pa'i skyabs gnas su 'dug spyan ras gzigs// gsol ba 'debs so rje btsun snying rje'i gter// thugs rjes la'ur gzigs dang 'jig rten dbang*// byin rlabs dngos grub zhu'o lhag pa'i lha// lha mi'i dbang po stobs ldan kun 'joms pa'i// 'chi bdag bde chen des ni bdag cag kyang*// shul lam 'phrang du dbang med khrid tsa na// gzhan pa'i/ skyes nas da phan don med las la zad// da ni dam 'chi cha med rgas la thug /dal 'byor stong log song la 'gyod tsa na// yar gyi mthon po'i dpal la sbrus kyin bzas/ mar gyi khral mi bzhur zhing bag med spyad// 'di 'dra'i lan chags phyi ma 'jal dgos tshe// bskyangs kyin lod rung 'ga' zhig gnyen snyam brtse// sus phan des pa med kyang la lar sdang*// thams cad mar gyur shes nas 'gyod tsa na// byams pa'i gnyen bskyur bsags pa'i nor bzhag cing*// mnga' ris bor te 'jur mig bar do'i 'phrang*// sgron me lag stong shad tshe ci drag na// 'dod pa ma khengs dge ba'i bshes la smad// ku re kyal khas yon gnas rnams la smre// de 'dra'i rnam smin ngan 'gror lhung tsa na// da ni mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs bsten nas// snying nas dam pa'i chos la phyogs pa yi// byang chub spyod pa rgya mtshor sleb kyi ring*// mdor na skye ba 'di dang bar do gzhan// byang chub snying por sleb pa de bar du// blo gtad re sa khyod nyid gcig pu ste// mi dbang mtsho skyes rdo rje dran gyur pa'i// skyo bsangs pa'i ra zlar khyod sbran nas// mi dbang de dang bdag cag khyod mdun du// lhan cig chos (7na13)kyi dga' bas 'tsho bar shog

/ces pa 'di gzhis ka chos rgyal lhun grub rtse'i yangs pa can gyi 'dun sar 'bog kong gdan sa pas zhus pa'i ngor padma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// /rgyal bas mdo rgyud kun nas bla ma nyid// mnyes byed chos kyi snying por gsungs pas na// skyes chen dam pa thams cad dang du bzhes// de tshul khyod la snang bas blo ba dga'// rkyen ngan khrag khrig spungs kyang nyam mi nga*// dge legs bye pa rnyed kyang mi dpa' ba// sngon dus 'brug pa'i sgom chen rnams la yod// de yang khyod blor song bas bdag sems mgu// cal sgrog blun po'i gtam rjes mi snyegs par// dpyod ldan mkhas la yid ches 'di lta bu// dam pa'i spyod pa rdo la bris 'dra bas// khyod tshul bsams kyin bdag ni yi rang skyes// zhes rgyal byad tshal du dge slong la gdams pa'o/// /dal 'byor kyi mi lus rnyed dka' ba// sngon bsags kyi dpal las thob dus 'dir// snying nas kyi chos gcig ma byas na// 'di thob pas phan pa e 'dug gzigs// dus gtan gyi skyabs mgon mtshan ldan rje// 'bral med snying gi dkyil du bsgoms// blo re ltos 'chos la gsol ba thob// rkyen gang byung thugs rjer shes pa dang*// 'jig rten gyi skye bos dben pa'i gnas// mi med kyi ri la mi tshe skyol// skyid 'dod kyi 'khri ba rbad chod la// ma bcos pa'i sems la goms 'dris gyis// kun khyab kyi ye shes chen po 'di// yin pa la yin par ngo shes pa// gsang sngags kyi lam du rgyal bas gsungs// za chos la ma brtson gnas lugs bsgoms// tha snyad kyi chong la zad pa med// lam zab kyi gdams ngag ri la bsgoms// ri khrod du shi bas chos mgo thon// chos phyir du shi bas bsam don rdzogs// rang 'dod kyi bsam pa yul phud la// rtogs ldan gyi rje la gsol ba thob// mchog thun mong gi dngos grub 'byung bar nges// re ma che chags med kyi lha chos (7ba14)gyis// zhes zang zang ne'u ring pa chos skyong bde legs la gdams pa'o/// /chos brgyad tshe 'di'i snang ba bor// bla ma rje la blo sems gtod// dben pa'i ri la sgom nas sdod// ma rgan 'gro drug don la 'bungs// dge slong don grub dpal 'byor la gdams pa'o/// /dang por byams dang snying rje byang sems sbyongs// de nas phyag rgya che la babs kyis gzhol// brtan pa thob phyir gnyis med spyod pa skyong*// lag tu long na sangs rgyas the mi tshom// zang zang ne'u ring pa karma tshe ring la gdams pa'o/// /dpal 'thung spyod grong gi nags 'dab na// zong 'dod dgus gang ba bod yul shar// mi skal bzang rol pa'i zhing khams su// rigs sngags skyes dge slong padma dkar// gnas ci zhig nges pas ma bcings pas// rje ras chung bla ma'i gdan sar sleb// sems bcos ma'i 'jog thabs ma rnyed kyang*// rang babs kyi ngang nas snang grags kun// rang bzhin stong pa'i nges shes rnyed// stong nyid dang snang ba dbyer med 'dres// yod med kyi sgro 'dogs gcod pas 'phongs// 'khrul rdzogs snang ba rang sar bstan// gnyen po'i ye shes ma rnyed pas// dgag sgrub kyi mtshan ma spros sam ci/// /ma smad yon tan kun gyi rab dkar zhing*// legs bshad mgrin rnga brdung la zla med pa'i// rgyal sras ngang pa'i gtso bo ras chung pa// bdag cag 'gro ba'i yid mtshor rol bar mdzod// sdug bsngal 'dzin 'khri rab tu 'khrigs gyur pa'i// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung ba'i 'gro ba rnams// byams dang thugs rje'i phyag gis legs drangs nas// rnam grol skam sar zhog cig rje btsun lags// padma dkar pos byas pa'o/// /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs dang gra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems (8na15)dpa' sems dpa' chen spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mthu chen thob la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas de dag la dmigs nas lan bdun brjod// dbugs bsngams rang lus 'jig rten dbang phyug sku// phyi lha nang stong dbus na dbu ma'i rtsa// tshangs bug nas bzung lte ba'i bar du sleb// 'og zum steng ni rgya gling go bzlog bzhin// snying thad rang gi rnam par shes pa hrīḥ

spyi bo'i thad mdun bla ma 'od dpag med// thugs kar hrīḥyig 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs// tshangs bug nas 'ong bdag gi snying hrīr zug /ngag tu hig brjod des hrīḥyar yar drangs// tshangs bug nas 'thon ston pa'i thugs kar thim// bdag ni 'di nas tsho 'phos gyur ma thag /bde ba can du rdzus te skye bar shog /der skyes nas ni 'od dpag med pa'i drung*// byang chub spyod pa mchog la slob byed shog /ces lan mang du brjod do// bde ba can gyi 'pho ba'o// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gsum gyi mtshan gang gis dran pa tsam gyis zhing der skye bar bde ba can gyi zhing bkod nas gsungs ba bzhin/ gsang sngags chos gling du gdams pa'o/// /lus ngag yid gsum rnal du phab// mtshan ldan bla ma spyi bor bsgom// yang dang yang du gsol ba thob// mthar gnyis su med pa bstim nas su// dpyad dpyad bsam bsam mi bya bar// gang shar steng du lhug par bzhag /mi sdod 'gro na su 'gro blta// bltas pas mi mthong dngos med zhig /cang med min pas dngos po yang*// gang byas mi 'gal spang blang zhi// de sgom pa po la gnad du che// shel dkar chos mdzad la gdams pa'o/// /oṃ swa sti// mi lus yid bzhin 'di ni thengs gcig tsam// de yang 'chi bdag gtum pos nam 'joms med// de la phan nges dam pa'i lha chos yin// snying nas snyoms (8ba16)las dor cag padma dkar// gzhon pa'i lang tsho 'di ni yud tsam nas// la 'ur rgas pa'i nad kyis 'dzin par nges// de tshe blo dang 'byung bzhi rgud lags pas// da lta 'bad pa thon cig padma dkar// nye 'khor dag ni tshong 'dus gnas 'gron bzhin// myur du 'bral bar nges pa'i tshul mthor nas// zhen chags sred pa skye ba ma 'khrul lam// sems nyid nang du khug gcig padma dkar/// /na mo lo ka shwa ra ye// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal zhi 'dod na// bgrang yas 'gro ba kun la brtse ba'i gnyen// spyan ras gzigs la snying nas skyabs zhus la// yig drug rem las bgrongs dang shes ldan tsho// snyigs dus tshe 'di dgun ka'i nyi ma bzhin// long med myur du 'jig par nges lags pas// snyoms las le lo sos dal ma bzhugs par// yig drug 'di la kun gyis brtson 'grus zhu// mi rnams phal che dus min 'chi ba la// rtag tu re ba'i ngang ring ci la khom// de bas nyin med mtshan med zhal 'di las// yig drug lhang nge bgrongs dang shes ldan tshe// mi phan tshe 'di'i bya bas ma brel bar// phan nges dam pa'i chos la bsgril re ran// snying nas 'chi bdag bdud la soms mdzod la// chos kyi snying po yig drug 'di la bsgril// bde zhing skyid dge ba'i 'bras bu lags// sdig pa'i las la sdug bsngal kho na 'byung*// de phyir 'dam kha log par ma mdzad par// dam chos ma ṇi 'dren la brtson par 'tshal// tshe 'di'i legs pa sngar bsags 'bras bu yin// phyi ma'i don rnams da res ma bsgrubs na/

gar skyes rang dbang med do shes ldan rnams// snying nas yig drug 'di la thugs dam 'tshal// bde sdug thams cad mi rtag 'gyur ba'i chos// bsam na blo gtad thub pa med bzhin du// 'phral skyid mnga' thang re la ra rgyal ba// mi de dang bslus yin no ma ṇi ba/ gzhan don thams cad rang gi yon tan (9na17)rgyu/ bsam med po gcig rang phan nyid la sgril// snyigs dus chos pa ha la la yid cig skyo// 'khrul med ma ṇi 'di la 'bungs mdzod dang*// kha shad khram pa'i chos kyis rgyud mi 'thul// blun sgom 'dag sbyar 'di yang 'tshang re che// khe che nyan chung chos de rgyal bas kyang*// yig drug 'dren pa 'di ka yin par gsungs/// /dam chos byed pa'i mi lus/ yang yang thob par mi 'dug /khar rjes lan cig rnyed dus// gtan gyi don la rems dang*// rnyed dka'i dal 'byor de yang*// tshul khrims bsrungs na thob pas// mi dge bcu po spangs pa'i// dge ba'i las la 'bad dang*// mtho ris thar par 'dzeg gam// ngan 'gro'i g.yang sar 'bab pa// rang dbang rang la yod dus// 'dam kha yar la gyis dang*// 'chi bdag gtum po de ni// dal brel lta bar mi 'dug /thog rgyugs nam yong med pas// snying nas lha chos gyis dang*// sngan mas bsags pa'i nor rdzas// sus za e 'dug gzigs la// ser sna'i mdud pa bkrol nas// bsags tshad sbyin par thod dang*// skyes nas skad cig mi sdod// 'chi bdag drung du snyeg pas// rtag rtsis phye bshol ma khom// blo sna chos la sgyur dang*// 'chi kha ma yi mi la// bshol 'debs thub kyi e 'dug /bslus bas lhus sa med pa// rang la'ang nges par 'ong ngo*// sna mchog grong ge sā lang*/ thub dbang de yang gshegs na// snying po med pa'i lus tsho// mi rtag 'jig pa a cang*// las 'bras bslu ba med cing*// skyid sdug dge sdig rjes 'brang*// des na sdig pa bskyur nas// dge ba dum re gyis dang*// zug rngu en tsam bsams kyin// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sus bzod// sdug bsngal bskyur bas mi 'khyur// nyon mongs las de spongs dang*// gtan gyi skyabs gnas zhu sa// mtshan ldan bla ma bzang ste// dkon mchog gsum 'dus yin 'dug

/gsol ba (9ba18)snying nas thob dang*// bsten pa'i lha la su bzang*// spyan ras gzigs dbang rgyal sras// rgyal ba'i thugs rje 'dus nas// sems can don la byon 'dug /'dren pa'i sngags de yig drug /phan yon bshad pas mi rdzogs// bod 'bangs kun gyi sngags skal// rem las gsung dang khrom pa// bshad kyang kha yi khram pa// bsgoms kyang blun bsgom ngang du// phal cher 'gro yi 'dug pas// rang blo ma ṇir sgril dang*// ma ṇi ba yi snying gtam// rgyal sde khrom la zhus pa// gsan dgongs mdzad na e legs// khyed rang rnam pas gzigs la// snying po ma ṇir sgril dang*/// /na mo gu ru/ zhing khams 'dzam gling byang gi phyogs// gangs can barpa ta nyid na// 'jam dbyangs mi yi gzugs sprul pa// ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po yi// thugs rjes byin gyis brlabs pa'i bu// rnal 'byor ngag dbang nor bu nga*// 'jig rten 'khor ba'i bya ba la// dgos med bsam pa skyes lags pas// gang la'ang zhen pa med pas skyid// ci byas kyang skyid pa'i sprang po nga*// mtshan ldan gyi bla ma dam pa la// zhen med kyi mos gus byas lags pas// bla ma rang sems su shes pas skyid// skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du// ma rgan gyi 'gro drug sems can la// snying rje dang gzhan don bgyis lags pas// da lta rang 'dod bral bas skyid// bde gshegs kyi bstan pa la bsams nas// yang yang du sprul pa'i tshul bzung ste// gzugs sku gnyis shugs las thob ste skyid// rje yongs 'dzin dam pa'i byin brlabs kyis// lhan skyes kyi rang bzhin chos kyi sku// bde blag tu rtogs pas bdag re skyid// a la la skyid pa'i nyi ma shar// a ho ya'i srid pa'i bde ba yis// 'gran min gyi bde ba khong nas rgyas// a kyang ku re bgyis pa lags// 'phags pa rnams dgongs pa mi khrel 'tshal// zhes pa 'di yang gnyal gyi sa'i cha// pho (10na19)brang lhun grub yang rtse'i po ta lar sbyar ba dge// rgyal ba'i snying rje'i gter rnams// gcig tu bsdus pa'i 'phags mchog

/spyan ras gzigs dbang khyed la// snying rje'i rgyang 'bod thal lo// sems can thams cad sgrol bar// mgon po khyod kyis dam bcas// bdag sogs da dung 'khyams pa// skyobs shig spyan ras gzigs dbang*// ma rungs sdig la spyad pas// sangs rgyas kun gyis ma 'thul// snyigs dus 'di du 'khor ba// skyobs shig spyan ras gzigs dbang*// bzod dka'i mtshon chas gtub cing*// bskal mes sreg dang 'tshod pa// las ngan rnam smin rdol rnams// skyobs shig /lto che kha skams mig zhan// bkres skom cho nges khol ba// nyam thag gshin rje'i 'jig rten// skyobs shig /brdeg 'tshog bkol dang gsod pa// gcig la gcig zas rmongs pas// slar yang ngan 'gror gzhol kun/ skyobs shig /rang dbang yud tsam yod dus// sdig la hab sha byas nas/ ngan 'gror chas pa'i mi tshe// skyobs shig /rang gi 'byor pas ma tshim// gzhan gyi dpal la sdang bas// khro 'khrugs 'thab pa'i lha min// skyobs shig /chog shes med pas 'byor pa// spyad pas sngar dge zad pa'i// chos kyi 'phongs pa'i mtho ris// skyobs shig /kha chos zhe la med pas// chos brgyad ga bur gyur te// kun slong gcig pu shes rnams// skyobs shig /dad rdzas khong du brdzangs nas// bag med las kar len pa'i// gzugs btsun dred po'i tshogs rnams// skyobs shig spyan ras gzigs dbang*// mi bzang 'khor ba'i brtson rar// nyam thag sdug gis e mnar// bsam mno btang tsho bgros nas// dam pa'i chos la gshegs dang*// gnod mang tshe la rtag 'dzin/ dang gis rang bslus nges so// 'chi dran dad pa ldan tsho// dam pa'i chos la gshegs dang*/ (10ba20)gtan don sgrub pa'i mi lus// mtshan mo'i glog ltar yun thung*// stong log mi gtong ba na// dam pa'i/ bar dor gshin rje'i drung du// dkar nag rde'u spungs tshe// sdig la 'gyod kyang 'phyis kyi// dam pa'i/ skyid 'dod sdig pa spyad pas// je sdug je sdug 'gro pa'i// 'khor bar chags rgyu ci yod// dam pa'i/

snga mas byas pa'i mdo tsam// phyi ma byas pa'ang de 'dra// don med las la ma 'byams// dam pa'i// bsags pa'i mtha' ma 'dzad cing*// 'dus pa'i tha ma 'bral ba// brtsigs pa'i tha ma 'gyel bas// mi rtag rtag par 'dzin dang*// mi phan phan par re ba// mi gtsang gtsang 'dzin bor nas// dam pa'i chos la gshegs dang*// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs nas// byang chub sems la sbyangs te// mar gyur drin len bsab phyir// dam pa'i chos la gshegs dang*// mtshan ldan gyi bla ma spyi bor bsgoms// sgo gsum chig dril gyi gsol 'debs byas// sems ji bzhin 'di yi ngang du gzhag /de rang ngo shes// phyag chen yin// shes so/// /mtshon grags pa can gyi ra lung pa// pha byin rlabs can gyi zhabs pad zung*// khong sa gsum 'gro ba'i zur phud la// yid bzhin gyi nor bur gyur phyir btud// khyed bsod nams can gyi mi dbang la// khong gna'i mi mdzangs pa'i lugs 'ga' tsam// 'jig rten gyi rgan rabs shes ldan bzhin// cung zad cig gsol gyi ma yengs gson// dus sangs rgyas byon pa'i zhing du 'khrungs// mchog dge ba'i bshes kyi rten ma bzang*// don dam pas spyod pa dar ba'i tshe// dus gtan don bsgrubs na cang hrig grung*// mi chen po phal gyi tshe 'di la// thugs zhen chags tsha bas sdig la ha pa/ 'phral kha nye mig nye'i dbang btang nas/ tshe phyi ma phan chad yal bar 'bor// khyod de bzhin ma mdzad chos bzhin spyod// ma rabs po ngan pa'i bya ba spongs// blo gtad thub (11na21)mnga' 'bangs byams pas skyongs// sangs rgyas kyi bstan la sri zhur mdzod// lus srog gcod 'dod g.yem ma byin len// ngag brdzun phra tshig rtsub 'khyal par smra// yid brnab sems gnod sems log lta bcu// 'di ngan 'gror 'phen pa'i lam yin la// rang lha mi'i rten 'byor dus kyis kyang*// tshe thung dang nad mang gnod pa kun// de kho nas byas phyir dug zas bzhin// bcu po de spang ba dge bcu'i khrims// 'di mngon par mtho pa 'dzeg pa'i skas/

rten rnam par thar pa skye ba'i sgo// thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i yul// tshe yun thung nam 'chi dus btab med// des na dge sgrub la phyi bshol spong*// las byas pa mdo yod bsod nams bsags// der rgyu 'bras bsams kyin blang dor mdzod// sbyin pa dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ rten rdo rje'i lus la rlung sems gcun// phyag mtshan sgom pa'i tsaṇḍa lis// sems khar 'jog pa'i gtum mo spor// der thig le nā da'i dpyid thig gis// mtha' log phyag rgya chen po 'grub// lam 'di lta'i gnad la dbang 'byor pa// nged dpal ldan 'brug pa'i bu brgyud yin// pha bzang gis bskyangs pa'i bu slob rnams// bde chen gyi gnas su kha yan 'phyo// zhes rgyal mkhar rtser sde pa dad pa bzhin mi 'gyur mtshan 'dzin pa la padma dkar pos gdams pa'o/// /rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// spyir sgom chen gyi mkhyen rgya rnam rtog rgyu// sgo sa mi rgan khyod nyams su len pa la// lus gdod ma nas dag pa lha yi sku// 'ja' tshon ltar gsal ba'i spyi gtsug tu// khong dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*// (11ba22)pha bla ma las gzhan du mi blta bar// ma sems can rnams 'khor ba las bsgral phyir// mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob 'dod pas// tshe 'di nyid nas rnam pa thams cad du// skyabs mgon dang re sa gzhan med par// yid rtse gcig tu gsol ba drag po thob// pha bla ma'i snang brnyan 'od du zhu// bdag lus la thim pas dbyer med 'dres// nam mkha' la nam mkha' ji bzhin du// gnas lugs kyi dang du gnyis med gzhag /bzhag pa ltar gnas na rtse gcig zer// sems rang thog tu sleb na spros pa bral// kun zung 'jug tu shes na ro gcig rtogs// sgom med sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa yin// mdo rgyud kyi snying po mos gus la// bgrad thang rtogs ldan gyi chos skal gyis// blo rtse gcig bsgrub 'dod kho na bas// gnas dben pa bsten cig rang rgyud sbyongs// sems yengs med dran pas gzhur thub na// khong bying rgod kyi 'phrang la 'jigs mi dgos// grogs bzang po brtson 'grus gces pa yin// bogs mos gus kyis 'thon pas gsol ba thob// ma 'gro drug tu shes na byang sems skyes// chos ci byas bla med kyi byang chub bsngos// zhes gdams pa'o/// /sems dbang po'i grong la 'khyams bcug na// phyi gzung ba'i snang ba mi 'gag la// nang 'dzin pa'i bya bas bag chags 'gugs// mngon byang gi gzigs mo 'byung bar dka'// sems bzo bcos med pa'i klong du bcug

/dran shes bzhin sgo ba bzang po bskos// bltar med kyi ltad mo de la 'char// dgag gzhag gi yul las 'das pas na// bla ma dkon mchog legs 'dzin la gnang ba'o// na mo gu ru bhyaḥbaka' bla med chos kyi sgron me yis// srid gsum gyi mun pa sel mdzad pa'i// brgyud pa gcig yod pa dkar brgyud ces// de srid zhi'i dpal 'byor yin par nges// don chos kyi sku las gzhan du med// ye gdod (12na23)nas gnas pa'i rang gi sems// de sangs rgyas dngos su ngo sprod pa'i// bla ma gcig yod pa ngag gi dbang*// rigs kun gyi khyab bdag yin par nges// tha mal shes pa las gzhan du med// mchog thun mong gi dngos grub rnam gnyis po// bde blag tu stsol bar mdzad pa yi// yi dam cig yod pa 'khor lo sdom// de brtan g.yo kun gyi rang bzhin yin// don lhan cig skyes las gzhan du med// bdud bzhi yi bar chad ji snyed pa// de thugs rjes 'joms par byed pa yi// chos skyong zhig yod pa phyag bzhi pa// dpal he ru ka dang dbyer med pa'i// ye shes kyi rtsa la las gzhan du med// 'phrin las kun ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin// thogs med du sgrub par byed pa yi// mkha' 'gro cig yod pa dud sol ma// dus gsum gyi rgyal ba'i yum mchog de// stong nyid kyi don las gzhan du med// gnad zab cing rgya che ba'i bdag nyid can// las kun las phul du byung ba yi// gdams ngag cig yod pa sdong po gsum// tshe gcig la sangs rgyas ster bar nges// 'gag med kyi rtsal las gzhan du med// don tha snyad tshig gi brjod bral zhing*/ de gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo can// lta ba cig yod pa khas len bral// de rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs pa yin// rang sems las gzhan du yod pa min// bsgom bya sgom byed kyi mtshan ma yi// mtha' de las 'das pa'i bdag nyid can// sgom pa cig yod pa yid byed bral// de 'khor 'das kun gyi rang bzhin te// don gnyug ma'i ye shes las gzhan du med// 'di bya dang 'di byed las 'das shing*// bza' gtad dang phyogs lhung bral ba yi// spyod pa cig yod pa blang dor bral// de zhen med lhug par spyod pa nyid// don zag pa med las gzhan du med// 'gyur ba med pa'i lhan cig skyes// de 'ching ba kun las 'das pa yi// 'bras bu zhig yod pa de dogs bral// de yang dag don gyi rgyal (12ba24)ba ste/

chos nyid kyi gtan yul zin las med// don de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas// pha bla ma'i chos srid zin pa yin// dkar brgyud kyi bstan pa'i mnga' bdag nyid// de ngag dbang nor bu'i myong glu yin// mi skal bzang 'ga' zhig ma gtogs pa// don kun gyis go ba dka' mo mchi// zhes pa bkra shis mthong smon du shugs 'byung du bgyis pa'o/// /na maḥshrī wa gand+rī ya/ pha grub pa'i dbang phyug chos kyi rgyal// che rabs kyi 'dren pa sku drin can// dpal kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang po de// bdag gi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs su gsol// rje 'brug pa'i brgyud 'dzin bla ma'i bu// ri khrod pa'i dge slong ngag gi dbang*// kun dga' yi rnam rgyal skad pa la// khyed bya ba btang ba'i rnal 'byor ba// sangs rgyas kyi rgya mtsho zhes grags pas// mi phyed pa'i dad pa'i shugs drag gis// bka' dam pa'i bdud rtsi dgos so skad// tshig sdebs sbyor mkhas po mi shes kyang*// mi khyod kyi ngo gdong ma bzlog pas// don cung zad bkod de ma yengs nyon// sngon rgyal ba chos kyi spyan ldan des// sems can gyi blo dang gang 'tshams par// chos brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa yang*// don rang sems 'od gsal chos skur 'dus// rnam rtog gis 'khor bar snang ba yang*// don chos sku nyid las gzhan ma yin// dpe chu bo gcig las 'khyag rum dang*// rba rlabs dang rlabs med cir yang snang*// chu bo yi ngo bor gcig pa ltar// cir snang mdzad phyag rgya chen po las// logs nas gzhan pa yod ma yin// rang nyid la yod pa'i sangs rgyas te// mi mthong bar gzhan nas 'tshol ba mang*// gtam tshig gsum bya btang rgan po yi// yid dkyil du zhog cig sangs rgyas pa// mi khyed dang bya bral dge slong nga*// skyab nas tshe rabs thams cad du// 'bral med du dam pa'i chos spyod cing*// rnam mkhyen kyi (13na25)sangs rgyas myur thob shog

/mnyam grogs rang tshod bzung ba'i bsten thabs 'di// byin rlabs rlung la bskur ba'i rgyur 'dug pas// rnyed dka' rnyed pa'i bsam pa rtag bcangs nas// mnyes par bya la 'bad pa bslab bya yin/ zhu ba'i dus su thos lor bzhag pa 'di// lag len rlung la bskur ba'i rgyur 'dug pas// tshig don zhu gtug byed cing nyams 'og gzhug /nyan tshad rgyud la nges khel brlab bya yin// da lta gzhog mthong phyis nas bya'o snyam// nyams len rlung la bskur ba'i rgyur 'dug pas// mi rtag 'chi ba nam yod nges med pas// dran pa'i mdo rang sgrub pa bslab bya yin// gzims dpon 'jam dbyangs pad dkar la bslab byar gdams pa'o/// /zang zing gi longs spyod 'dus dus na// dgos med kyi blo snas rdog brdzis byas// dben gnas gang mthor bgrod pa de// zhen log pa'i rnam thar yin pas bsngags// mos sgom gyi gnyen po rgyang bsrings nas// yin lugs kyi steng du ma yengs bzhag /las zin skyes bu de la 'byung*// phyogs bral gyi rnal 'byor blo re bde// 'gro drug la dmigs pa'i byang sems kyang*// 'khrul snang la gsal 'debs yin mthong nas// bdag gzhan mnyam nyid kyi glong yangs su// 'khor gsum dag pa'i sems sbyangs 'tshal// sku gnyis lhun grub cig de la 'byung*// nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyu 'bras zer// ro gcig du mar shar 'dis su// sgom med kyi rgyal khams bkra yin// ces pa 'di yang ne ring sgrub chen la gnang ba'o/// /kwa ye lta yi bla ma'i blo gros byin// kha ba'i ri ltar spungs 'thug bsod nams gzis// ga la brgyan pa'i sa spyod de yi tshig /nga yi yid kyi ngal ba'i gsos su smin// ca re khyod kyi grags snyan gur kum char/ cha tsam min la bstod pa'i tsa ta ka /ja yi lo ma lta bu'i gshog brkyang nas// nya rgyas (13ba26)zla ba'i grong khyer de drung 'phur// ta thā ga ta'i bstan la sbyin pa'i bdag

/tha mal srid pa'i lus kyis mi mgu bar// da lta chos kyi nor can 'cho */ na gdung ma bsam pa yi phyogs 'dir 'ongs// pa ra ma yi tshul la 'dris pa'i zhar// pha rol tha snyad tshogs kyi mgron bstabs pas// ba bzhin tshig gi 'dod 'jo sbyin nus pas// ma lus 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor 'gyur ba'i phyir// tsa ri tra ltar dben pa'i nags nang du// tsha grangs bzod pa'i bsam gtan sgom 'dod kyang*// dza lang skye bo'i khrod 'dir rtag lhung bas// wa ler lha chos dran kyang phyi bshol las// zhwa ltar mkhas btsun bzang bkur mi dbang khyed// tha ma'i mgron las lhag pas snyigs dus la// la'ur med pa'i bde la sbyor zhig ces/ ya rabs khyod kyis rna ba'i rgyan du bsrings// rā dza phal cher mi bsrun 'di 'dra'i dus// la lar nor phyir srog kyang 'tshong phod pa// sha za lta bu'i khrel med kyis// gang ba'i/ sa steng 'di na bdag gis ci byar mchis// ha cang mdza' ba'i spyi brtol smras pa la// a la la zhes khyod kyis dgongs par rigs// de skad bkra shis rnam par rgyal ba nas// bkra shis kha btags skyes bcas bsrings pa dge// /lha rigs phun tshogs dga' ba'i tshal nang du// sngon bsags las 'phro brdar son legs smin nas// tshul ldan dang po'i myu gu phrar mthon pa// bskyangs pas thos bsam yal 'dab rdzogs pa des// snyan pa'i dri len dang ba'i pho nya bas// 'bigs byed khyod blor chags pa'i des gsar sprin// rtsom pa'i gru char du bzhu 'di phob ces// bskul la spro ba'i dbyar skyes rngar bcas bsrings// blo rtul char sdod tsa ra ka yi wa// ngoms pa ṇa ma ma rnon klu dbang sde'i// rnam dpyod nyer 'tsho'i chu klung spel ba'i 'os// zhib mo zhib mor byed pa'i shes rab lces// myang pas shes mod brtags nas ji 'dra'i lan// mngag gzhug na bun (14na27)gzhon nu 'di la bskur// char 'di rang blo dad pa'i rjes 'brangs su// babs par khyos mthong chen sbyangs stobs kyis// nyi 'od bkye nas lung rigs dbang po'i gzhus// kun dga'i ngo mtshar ston gyi ltad mor byon// phyogs lhung than pa chen pos ma gcos pa'i// smra ba'i nags nang der ni kho bo'i yid// dang bas bstod tshig ca co spel byed pa// thar 'dod mdongs tha can gyi rtse dga'i gnyen// tshig sbyor gyis bkra don bzang bsung zhim pa// legs bshad gsar pa gsar pa'i dpal yon gyis// thub bstan utpal mthing kha'i tshal dar la// brtson 'di mkhas pa'i snyan gong phyogs lhung dbang*// bshad pa'i ge sar g.yo ba tsam min pa// lag khrid gdams pa'i sbrang rtsir smin pas kyang*// skal bzang bung ba'i dpyid du chos smra'i mtshor// legs so'i nyi 'od 'thung de pad dkar lo/// /chos zab dgu'i nying khu gsol gsol nas// snod ldan gyi ngo na skyug mkhan de// dkar brgyud kyi gser sbrang rkang drug ldan// rnam grol gyi mkha' la 'phur rnams yin// khyod de rjes 'brang ba'i rnal 'byor pa// bla ma slob dpon gyi khur 'dzin spangs// sgrub chen chos skyong bde legs khyod// mi med kyi dben dgu 'grim 'dod par// nga rjes su yi rang skyes nas su// nan tan dang dbu tshugs ma byas so// dus da lta snyigs ma lnga bdo'i nang*// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' skad// mi gzhan legs mthong na thugs 'khrugs nas// skyon med kyi mi la mi kha 'chos// las 'bras bslu med kyi gnad go bas/

rang smod pa'i 'dam du lhung gyur na// las sngon byas 'dag bsam dga' ba skyed// kha gtong la de tsam ma 'jigs pa// de tsam gyi bstod ra gtong mkhan snang*// rang byas la g.yo sgyu ma zhugs pa// chos lag len du bsgril ba'i mdo sde yin// de bdag bstod smad (14ba28)mnyam nyid 'byongs// khor gzhan lugs dad na dad pas legs// dag snang 'byongs pa'i chos lugs yin// ma dad na btang snyoms gzhog la thong*// dgra zun gyi lab lob rna bar gzan// chags sdang gi bgyi ba zhe rtsa 'khrug /kha rog par sdad na de kas chog /chos snying po'i don la rang cag spyod// ma yengs pa'i 'jog pa gshis thog yin// snang grags byung na sgom gyi grogs// gang shar chos sku'i yo lang yin// zhes sgrub chen ne rings pa ti si la sogs pa'i khur 'khur gyi bla mar 'os snyam smras pas// tshe blos btang gi sgrub pa mthar skyel ba'i dgongs grol zhus dus zhal gdams su byas pa'o/// /rtag tu 'char la nub pa mi srid pa/ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i nyi ma'o// de dang de yi reg byas yid sim pas// thams cad rnam pa kun gyi phyag gi 'os// snyigs dus phyogs ris zug rngu ches pa dang*// sngon las kyis 'phangs smra mchu mang na yang*// rang spyod rgyal ba'i bstan las ma g.yos na// byas tshad 'tshengs pa yin no rigs kyi bu// ngos su tshul legs lkog tu bag 'khyal ba'i// dge sbyong 'jig rten mig ngor mdzes na yang*// gang byas rnam smin rang la 'ong 'dis su// mdzub mo bkug la rang rgyud rengs ma 'jug /bla chen rnams nas grwa rkyang snyoms chung bar// zang zing nor phyugs ngom zhing gzhan dga' yang*// de 'dra 'dul ba dmad pa'i las yin gyi// gang la'ang drod rigs 'dod chung chog shes gyis// bag chags ngan pa 'grogs yun ring 'dis su// gar sleb nges pa med pas sgo gsum spyod// ci byed sngon du legs par brtags nas su/

chos mthun gang yin la gzhan ma bshol/ sbyin pas bos la snyan pa'i gtam smra zhing*// don spyod bag phebs gyur nas don mthun par// gtan gyi don chen sgrub la sbyar nus na// 'gro don chen po 'ong gi the ma tshom// snyigs dus log (15na29)sgrub dar ba'i 'khor gyi khrod// bzod pa khong bden 'jam la thabs mkhas pas// rnal mar sgrub pa'i cho ga sbyor shes na// thams cad bdun pa lag pa'i rtse la 'ong*// gal te byas kyang tshabs su mi 'gro na// sngon las yin gyi de ru sdig pa sbyongs// dkon mchog gsum la ra mda' zhu ba las// gzhan pa'i thabs gzhan mi dgos de yis chog /tha snyad kyog po'i 'then khyer chos kyi dgra// de bskyur bka' dang dgongs 'grel gzhung kun dang*/ tshig don zhu dag thub pa'i thos pa la// bsam zhig btang na bstan pa gzung ba yang*// lan rer go ba dka' yang yang dang yang*// mjal dang nges rtogs dgos kyi de dang der// klog pa'i mod la yid sun mi skye bar// tshig don gar song gdos dang kun shes 'byung*// shin tu zab mo'i gnas la the tshom na// dad pa'i stobs las gzhan gyis rnyed dka' bas// mtshan ldan bla ma dam par blo bkal nas// rtse gcig gsol ba thob dang 'dod don 'grub// mdor na rang mthong skyon yin dman sa gzung*// gzhan ngor mi 'gro dge yang cam gyis zhog /phan 'gyur srog la mi blta sgrub la thug /de skad padma dkar po'i legs bshad gsung*// myangs na zhim pa gang la bsrings 'dis su// blo gsal bung ba'i sde rnams yid dga' ba'i// zlos gar chen pos sa 'di khyab gyur cig /ces rgyal byed tshal nas mdo grwa 'chad nyan pa 'jam dpal grags pa la padma dkar pos nyung dur gdams pa'o/// /rje nyi zla ltar grags rin po che// dpal ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal por 'dud// khyod sgrub brgyud 'dzin pa'i bu slob la// tshig mang po'i spros pa bgyi mi 'os// don nyams len gnad du dril te bshad// blo rtse gcig nyon dang bla sbyang pa// brgyud ldan gyi bla ma dam pa la// sangs rgyas dngos su mthong gyur na// tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas lag rtser zhon// de phyir mos gus la (15ba30)snying phud tshugs// lus 'dod nas grub pa'i ltar shes nas// gdangs rten dang brten par gsal 'debs tsam// don zung 'jug gi steng du bsgril gyur na// lha thams cad gcig gi 'grub par go// steng ro ma lam du byed pa'i sgo// a haṃ gi 'bros 'dod ya mtshan can// nyi zla 'phen sdud mi bgyid par// rlung dbu mar bcug na 'grub par go// 'og rkyang ma'i kha las 'dzag med bcings// rten pho nya'i gseb lam la phyin nas// chos phyag chen gyi rang zhal blta shel na// zung 'jug kyang ming du mi las snyam// zhes pa bla ma sbyang pa blo gros bla ma la gdams pa'o/// /skyabs kyi mthar thug bla ma rin po che// 'gro ba kun la brtse ba'i spyan ras gzigs// khyod la gsol ba 'debs so mkhyen pas dgongs// bdag rgyud khyed dang mnyam par byin gyis rlobs// de nas brtsams te gar skye thams cad du// yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes su khyod bsten pas// rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrub pa la// gegs med mchog tu dpa' bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes so/// /rje sngon gyi gdul bya'i snang ngo na// mtshan mi tra dzo ki lha yi gsol// dus da lta nged cag gdul bya'i phyir// dpal sgyu ma'i gar mkhan grub pa'i rje// nga dran pa'i gdung shugs je cher thal// pha mkhyen pas gzigs shig sku drin can// 'bangs yal bar 'dor gtan du gzigs// dus da lta zhal mjal zhus na bsam// pha bu la brtse ba'i dus la bab// ces stag rtse sgrub sder lo/// /bde chen dmu steng gnas mchog 'dir// mes po rje btsun ras pas byon// dag pa longs sku'i lha tshogs gzigs// dpa' bo dpa' mos dbus su mchod// bde chen gyi rol gar ci yang bkye// de phyir byin rlabs ya mtshan che// nga de la bsam nas bskor du 'ongs// skal ldan pho mo tshogs kyi mtshon// lha yi mngon dbyings su (16na31)dgyes pa nges// rgyud byin gyis brlabs pas rig pa 'ur// 'phral bcos ma'i 'khrigs ga rang sar zhig

/dbyings su rig pa thim pa snyam// snang ba tshogs su song ba snyam// nyams dga' bo zhig la gu yangs po// blo bde po zhig la rgya yan po// dngos grub myur du thob thob 'dra// dkar brgyud kyi rnam thar 'khyongs sam bsam// nyams dga' bo skyid do 'dir tshogs tshe// zhes bde chen dmu stegs su'o/// /mtshan thos pas 'khor bar mi ldog pa// dpal dgas po dka' brgyud byin rlabs can// lhag par sgrub brgyud 'brug pa'i rje// dus gsum du byon rnams kho bo'i skyabs// rtse gcig tu khong la blo gtad pas// don ngang gis grub pas 'tshengs par byung*// dad ldan gyi yon bdag khyed rang yang*// dus gtan gyi re bltos de la gtod// bsam pa thog khel zhig gdon mi za// rje de dag rnams kyi skyabs zhugs nas// las sdig pa byed pa mi rigs pas// dus de nas gzung ste dge bcu la// blo nus dang sbyar kyin bags kyis slobs// spyir khams gsum 'khor ba'i mtshang la ltos// sgos snyigs dus rtsod pa lhur len la// sems brtags gzhigs bcug na thar 'dod skyes// de smon lam gyis zin na lam du zhugs// rang don ming byed du ma las par// 'jig rten rgan po bsam shes can// gros 'dun la 'bad 'gran ma rgan rnams// bde thabs la brtson na byang chub mchog /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur// de phyir dge rtsa byang chub sngos// zhes der rgyas pa'i a'o la'o/// /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs shes nas thar 'dod kyi// byang chub rgyu la 'bad pa'i rtsom pa la// rtag tu bar chad med cing 'grus pa yis// bsam pa'i don kun 'grub par gyur cig gu// rdul tshon lus dang bha ga byang sems kyi// dkyil 'khor bzhir zhugs lus ngag yid rnam shes// bum (16ba32)gsang shes rab bzhi pa legs bsgrubs nas// sku bzhi mngon gyur dam tshig skyong bar shog /rang lus rdo rje phag mo lus dbus nang*// rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi nang las kyi rlung*// 'pho med bcings pa'i 'bar 'dzag nyams yin gyis// mchog gi gtum mo 'bar bar gyur cig gu// snang srid sgyu ma lta bur mthong ba'i mthus// 'jig rten chos brgyad mgo bo snyoms gyur nas// phung khams skye mched dag pa'i lhar gsal bos// nyin mtshan bar do lam du longs par shog

/chos rnams nyun gyi gnas lugs 'od gsal ma// phyag rgya che la mnyam gzhag goms shugs bus// mngon gyur zung 'jug nyid las rdo rje 'chang*// yan lag bdun ldan myur du 'grub par shog /tshe 'di'i snang ba nub par nye ba'i tshe// bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis mdun bsus nas// mkha' spyod chen po'i sa la 'phos nas su// gzhan don thams cad rtag tu byed par shog /ces so/// /gzhung brgya'i tshig la lha yi bla ma dang*// don 'byed koṇḍa nti ltar gyur pas/ lung rigs smra la spobs pa dge ba can// gang gi zhu 'phrin zla ba'i bzhin ras ni// tshig rgyan me tog 'phreng bas spud pa dang*// skyes lnga'i mdza' ba dang 'grogs bod yul shar// cog skar rgyu skar rgyu 'dra'i gseb son pas// sngar gyi yid gcugs srid la mngon sum bzhin// phyogs der slob 'dod rnams kyi re skong du// gang gi shes pa'i dpag bsam bkod gyur la// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dri bzang 'gyed pa'i tshul// thos pa'i lam zhugs grags pa'i pho nya bas// snying la sim pa byed du ngal ba byas// bdag kyang 'dus byas chos kyi gnas tshul las// bden gnyis rnam par bye ba'i tshul rtogs pas// nam mkha' sprin bcas sprin ni go 'byed par// ji bzhin bya ba thams cad lam du khyer// res 'ga' mkhas pa'i las (17na33)bsam gzhung lugs 'byed// res 'ga' grub pa'i shul 'dzin sgom bzlas byas// phal cher skye bo'i ngo bzhin 'gying bag ni// dbang phyug chen po'i mdun sa drung sleb tsam// thub pas 'dul ba'i lung las rab zhir bsngags// rang ngor de nyid kho nar snying por byas// lnga brgya pa rnams 'dod chen mthon por 'dzin// de phyir chen po'i srol yang ma bsnubs gzung*// bdag spyod 'di ltar khyod kyis shes gyur na// srid zhi mnyam pa mkha' dang lag mthil bzhin// bde sdug ro gcig tsan ste'u ste// bzang ngan ma mchis gser dang bong ba'i dpe// 'di dag kun rdzob yod ma myong bas dang*// don dam med ma myong bas ma grub skad// phyogs bral dbu ma'i lugs su zhugs gyur na// 'khor gsum dag pa'i nyams len lag rtser lon// phyag rgya chen po byas kyang de ka rang*// byas tshe dam pa'i chos las gzhan pa min// gdul bya 'dul ba'i 'phrin las rgya chen de// mkhas pa khyod kyis brtags kyin ri mor 'os// cung zad bsnyad 'di'i rten du byin brlabs pa'i// bdud rtsi'i ril bu nus pa mi bslu ba// kā la ku ṭa'i nad 'joms sman thums dang*// phyag rgya chen po'i bshad sbyar ngur smrig gi// mdangs 'dzin ther ma zung la rtags bkod de// sprin thogs chos kyi pho brang chen po nas// bshol ldan gsum pa'i tshes bcur brdzangs pa yin/// /tshe 'di blos btang gi rnam thar// lto gos gtam gsum la mi rtseg

/g.ya'i spang gangs khrod du sdod pa'i// mnyam med bla ma yi ring lugs// sgrub 'dod smon lam du byas nas// lag len mi khyu ru snyegs bas// rgyal srid 'dun thabs dang 'dres te// kha dang zhe phugs su 'dzol nas// mi dbang pho brang du 'khyams pa// snying nas skyo mo 'dras byung ngo*// rgyal kha pha rol la sbyin nas// pham kha rang skal du lon pa// bdag (17ba34)las gzhan gces su mthong ba'i// sems dpa' chen po tsho'i rnam thar// sgrub 'dod smon lam du byas nas// lag len dgra gnyen la chags pas// tshe 'di'i che thabs dang 'dres te// kha bshad kham gtam du lus nas// gzugs btsun ho 'dra'i gseb 'khyams pas// snying nas skyo mo 'dras byung ngo*// zhes pa 'di pho brang srong btsan du bgyis pa'o/// /gnas bkra shis bang sor bzhugs pa la// lus srog la phangs pa med pa dgos// phung po gzan skyar gyi gnad 'di kas// gnyan sa 'grim pa'i gcod du go// gnas bkra shis bang sor bzhugs pa la// lhags nged la 'jigs pa med pa dgos// sdug sran re ba'i gnad 'di kas// sgom chen phal cher gyi ras phud go// zhes so/// /rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje'i 'phrul chen po// ngo mtshar kun tu snang ba'i gzhal med khang*// jo bo rnam gnyis rtag par bsnyen pa 'di// bsod nams dam pa'i dam pa yin snyam mdzod// sdig pa che yang bshags pas mi 'dug med// des na sngar byas thams cad stobs bzhis shogs// phyin chad srog la bab na'ang mi bgyid ba// dran pas dbang po bsdams na 'grub pa yin// dge ba chung yang yongs su bsngo bas 'phel// byang chub bar du 'bras 'byin stobs cher 'gro// des na ci byas rang don ma yin par// sems can kun la ster ba thabs mkhas mchog /dge sdig bsam pa'i rtsa ba la rag pas// byed pa chos su e 'gro 'gro na bya// mi 'gro dug can zas bzhin 'dor ba'i phyir// shes bzhin bya ra rtag tu 'dzugs par bya// mdor na sdig spong dge ba bsgrub pa dang*// rang sems 'dul bar sde snod gsum 'dus pas// nyams su len pa snying por sgril shes mdzod// thos dang tshig rjes dpyad pa'i bsam pa dang*// 'jig rten sgom pa kun gyi snying po'i don// rtogs dka' rtogs byed dad pa kho na bar (18na35)mdo rgyud kun las gsungs phyir bshes gnyen sten// bla mas smras pa gang gi snying zhugs pa// lag pa'i mthil na gnas pa'i gter mthong bzhin// 'gyur nges bslu ba med pa'i tshig lags pas// yang dag don la mnyam par 'jog pa gces// zhes chos 'khor lha sar dkon gnyer gyis bskul nas padma dkar pos gdams pa'o/// /ngo mtshar ma lus 'khril ba'i gong bu gang*// snang bar byed pas nyi ma las 'gongs shing*// spyad kyin re ba kun 'grub nor bus kyang*// mi mtshon phyag 'os 'jam dpal de la 'dud// ma rig ma rtogs khong 'tshangs rnam 'gyur las// rigs ldan ris med 'od rnams 'dul ba la// thub dbang ma lus gzigs des gsung rab kyang*// rnam mang gsungs phyir theg kun dgongs pa can// de phyir gang yang rgya mtsho'i rgya lta bur// yangs pa'i blo gros khog tu bcug nas kyang*// srid zhur mdzad na dad pa can zhes bya// mi rgyal mdzad spyod chos su de 'gro nges// bod 'dir mkhas pa mang yang tshig re'i rjes// bsnyegs pas snying po'i phyogs la mjal mi spro// byang chub snying po'i spo la sngar byung bzhin// dpa' bor 'gyur 'dod don gyi snying po lon// dal ba rnyed dka' rnyed nas myur 'jig dang*// 'dus byas skad cig mi gnas khar chub kyang*// zang zing rnyed pa'i drung du de yar nas// brtseg rum rtsod pa lhur len 'dis skyo /sangs rgyas dngos soms gsol ba thob// ces pa 'di yang hor smad pa'i dpon ma la'o/// /stobs ldan lha dbang gi brgya byin// 'chi bdag bdud po yis gtses tshe// skyabs yul sangs rgyas la zhus nas// bsod nams tshogs bsags kyis bzlog 'dug /da lta bde skyid du 'dzom rung*// mi rtag 'jig pa 'dra 'ong nges// long yod lha chos kyi snying po// tshogs gnyis rdzogs thabs la 'bod cig /ces pa 'di'ang gzhug sna bar gnang ba'o/// /rje btsun bla ma khyod kyis rjes gzung nas// skye dang skye bar dam pa'i chos spyod cing*// khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las brgal te// rnam mkhyen nor bu'i gling du phyin par shog /skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du// dpal ldan 'brug pa'i bstan la legs zhugs nas// tshul gnas thos bsam sgom la 'bad pa yis// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa 'di'ang hor smad pa'i dpon mo la gnang ba'o/// /bstan skyong mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i spyir gnas nas// thar 'dod re skong legs bshad char 'bebs pas// dam chos rdzogs ldan dus bzhin rtag 'dzin pa// mi pham padma dkar por gsol ba 'debs// zhes pa 'di 'phan yul lcang gling chos sdings par gnang ba'o/// /zab rgyas chos kyi gter chen rnam phye nas// thar 'dod re ba skong ba'i skyabs gcig pu// rje btsun bla ma sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// padma dkar po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bdag gis dge ba ji ltar bsags pa'i mthus// skye dang skye bar (19na37)dge ba'i bshes rnyed cing*// byang chub chen po'i spyod la legs sbyangs te// rdo rje 'chang dbang myur du thob gyur cig /ces so/// /rje btsun padma dkar po khyod kho na// 'di dang phyi ma kun gyi skyabs te// dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bor bdag cag ni// dad cing dang bas phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// ji ltar rgya mtsho che la a ga st+ya// rgyal ba'i gzhung lugs kun la khyod nyid de// ma lus thugs su chud pa'i legs bshad kyi// chos sgra drag tu sgrog par gsol ba 'debs// gang thos bdag kyang ma rig sgrib bral bas// yang dag lam gyi pha mthar phyin thob cing*// de bar byang chub sems kyis rgyud sbyangs te// zhi dul nges pa'i dpal la spyod gyur cig

/ces pa 'di ri mo mkhan phyag rjes pa'i ngor padma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// /bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci bgyis pa// 'di nas gzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du// yon tan bdun ldan mi yi rten grub ste// rje btsun bla ma khyed zhabs mnyes byed cing*// rdo rje 'chang gi lam la 'bad gyur cig /ces rje btsun bsam 'phel nas la gnang ba'o/// /dgung bsangs mthon po yi phyogs su// nyi zla zung gcig gi 'khor lugs// ya mtshan dpe zla dang kral ba// lho phyogs dga' ston du chas byung*// me tog padma tsho skyid do// rgyal khams phyogs med kyi phyogs su// mtshan ldan bla ma yi 'gro don// yangs pa'i rgyal khams 'dir phebs bzhud// mchod yon zhal mjal la skyid do// zhes dang*/// /sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// ji srid byang chub snying po de srid du// skyabs zhus khyed kyi thugs rjes bdag cag la// rnam pa kun tu skyobs pa'i gsol ba 'debs// 'khor bar gnas pa'i tshe yang yon tan rten/ yon tan bdun ldan mtho ris thob gyur (19ba38)nas// sangs rgyas dgyes pa bskyed pa kun bsgrub la// rtag tu 'bad pas sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /ces pa 'di gnyis nang so re dga' nas me mor gdan 'dren zhabs tog la byon dus padma dkar pos bgyis so/// /dpal tsa ri trar byon dus kyi gzigs snang snyan dngags kyi 'phreng ba bzhugs so/// /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis zhabs brten pa'i// rdo rje btsun mo gang dang 'khor lo'i mgon// lhan cig skyes dga'i dpal du rol ba'i zhing*// tsa ri tra der dad pas phyag bgyi'o// dge legs rin chen bye ba phrag snyed kyis// 'jig rten gsum rnams skal bzang bgyid pa// sprul pa'i zhing du kho bo sleb pa'i tshe// ngo mtshar ltad mo'i dam pa 'di 'dra mthong*// nyi zla'i mig can mthon mthing nam mkha'i ral pa dang*// rgyu skar con pan glog gi 'phreng ba'i do shal can// sngo bsangs lus kyis phyogs kyi 'khor lo rnam 'gengs pa// chu 'dzin drag po'i gzigs mas bgegs rnams bcings pa bzhin// gangs ri'i bzhin ras brag skyibs utpal mig
